_comment: The time zones the hosted registry's schedule check (`checkSchedule` in workers/app/src/run_queue.js) stores or refuses, held by workers/app/test/run_queue.test.js on the Worker side and by tests/test_hosted_config.py on the container's (`_known_timezone` in src/cyris/config.py): every `stored` name is one the container reads, and every refused zone is one it refuses. A zone with `stored` null is refused.
